title: Clear-air turbulence — jet stream
blurb: A curved jet-stream core from the Great Basin to the Ohio Valley, with shear-driven CAT bands at FL310–FL390 drifting east.

title: Convective corridor
blurb: A line of thunderstorm cells from central Texas to Tennessee; deep, intense, compact turbulence FL200–FL410 drifting northeast.

title: Calm cruise
blurb: Smooth air everywhere: the detector should stay quiet. Only quantisation, flicker and autopilot wander are present.

title: Synthetic PIREP replay
blurb: Mountain-wave turbulence over the Colorado Rockies plus a weaker patch downstream, with many synthetic pilot reports to exercise the PIREP correlation window.
